checks.id: focus: the hero, a tab and Promises keep their element and the focus through eight clock ticks and a badge change
focus: a sheet's focused button ending moves the focus to the shell, then onFocusReturn once

focus: a final target bar (target.cancel false, 0.2.12) keeps its words and element with no Cancel; made final while Cancel has the focus, the focus comes back to the shell, reported once; Cancel is back when the choice can be left again

final.title: Position A3 fixed
final.sub: Resolves after the window · no effect shown now

checks.id: refused: an unavailable hero takes no tap and is described by its reason; a busy one takes none; an offered one fires once
refused: interactive: false takes no tap anywhere
stale: only Retry, ⋮, the target bar's Cancel and a sheet's back and close work; the rest say why

out: an eliminated player's banner has the pack's words and icon and no Retry, and leaves the controls as given; a docked sheet stays below it; it is this viewer's, so a new viewer or concealment drops it, and reconnecting takes its place while given

look.title: You’re out
look.sub: You can watch. Your role stays private.

checks.id: private: concealed, nothing to read and no control; the clock's place and the stage keep their size
private: a new viewer drops the last one's tabs, sheet, target, chip and Promises, unless the update gives the new viewer's
time: the clock shows what it is given (m:ss, rounded up), amber at 10 s and under, a ring when asked, and never counts by itself
layout: the bars and the stage are measured; text size, insets and the bars' changes are reported
layers: the cover lies over the stage and above all it holds, under the target bar, the banner, the toast and the sheet; over a sheet the toast stays on top and the banner under, as the pack
large: at the Largest text a row's value goes under its title and a stacking segmented control stacks; at the Standard text neither changes

textsize: after the text size changes on a live phone, a target bar, a chip and a sheet opened afterwards take the new size's rules, as parts open through the change and a shell mounted at that size do; back at the Standard text, the Standard rules
nobar: with bar: null the stage runs to the top edge, the overlays keep the bar's place, and slot('clock') keeps its element
edge: with edge: true the stage and its cover fill the shell under the bar, layout() gives the safe areas, and the overlays stay where they are

reach: the cover's reach (--ms-ps-cover-top, --ms-ps-cover-bottom) is how far it lies from the phone's edges, so a part in it reaches the whole phone: with the bars, with no bar, with the private talk's buttons, and edge to edge
backdrop: the room view's space behind the bars by default, the phone's canvas with backdrop: 'canvas', and nothing else
head: a sheet's head action sits before Close, keeps its focus, reports onSheetAction, works while reconnecting and returns the focus when it goes

footer: an action is primary, secondary or warn (the pack's Abort match, outlined in paper); a local one works while reconnecting, a command is refused with the banner's words, and interactive: false refuses both

staleWhy.abort: Controls return when the match is current

checks.id: talk: the private talk's two buttons stay inside the phone and whole at the Largest text on 320 × 568, a row each where they do not fit side by side; a docked sheet stays 10 px above them and layout().covered.bottom is how much they cover; at the Standard text, the pack's two equal columns
toast: shown once per id, gone after its time, and cleared by suspend()
toast: it takes no tap; a tap at its centre reaches the control under it
toast: words too long for one line wrap inside the phone and its paper holds them, at every text size on 390, 430 and 320 px phones; words that fit keep one line

words: the lit Blackout's line counts down (Lights out in 0:03, 0:02, 0:01) and the lights go out; the bar keeps its height, its right side keeps its elements and places, the focus stays and no layout is reported
hud: a long press shows a capped tab's word large at 200% text, and nothing at 100%

card: Card is the last tab and draws this viewer's own crew portrait as the top bar draws it, the same picture, shape and 32 px size; no character draws the card's tile; named Card, open announced, an amber ring only while open; the label keeps its level and the bar its height at every text size; concealed, a new viewer and the private talk draw none

tiles: every game tab's icon is a painted tile in the portrait's frame and 32 px box, at the portrait's place, the same for every viewer; only the open tab has the amber ring and label; an unavailable tab fades to 38 %; the round button's icon is painted, grey when unavailable; with no person given the bar draws no portrait and the same tiles; the private talk keeps its line icons

place: the toast never covers the bar, a banner or an open sheet's head: it takes the first free place below, 8 px clear, and keeps its own place when nothing is in its way, on 390, 430 and 320 px phones

squeeze: when a sheet's body would get under a third of the sheet, its footer scrolls with it: the wrapper is the scroller, the footer follows the body, the last button is reached by scrolling, a part inside the body scrolls into view and sheetBody is the same element; with room for the body nothing changes, on 320, 390 and 430 px phones

stack: a head whose title would take more than two lines beside its buttons stacks where that makes it shorter: its buttons on a row, Back at the left and Close at the right, then the title and its line on the full width; decided from hidden copies that leave nothing behind, and measured again only when the width, the text size, the title or the buttons change; the focus stays
observers: a sheet that goes, and its head, are no longer watched for their size, and a toast that goes is not either; after dispose nothing is watched

fit: no word of the top bar is cut, with the game's own names and its longest lines, on 320, 390, 402 and 430 px phones at the Standard, Large and Largest text; Promises is the handshake and its count everywhere, named for a screen reader; the clock has its icon only in a bar wider than 25 rem; a line the name displaces is still read; the bar stays inside the phone and the stage begins under it; and without the fit the same bars do cut
